admission.justification: Host publication/intake, native state selection, hierarchy joining, wire/store shape and task presentation jointly prevent a second task truth. Correct words over a competing collection, or a canonical map fed stale/unqualified host facts, cannot establish the guarantee. This proposed cross-boundary family leaves the approved Operations family and all its eight members untouched.

guarantee: A task has one qualified server entry and one browser task map: native document stage has precedence, bound host observations supply only started-task activity and event time, and declared lists with documented-subTask master validation and genuinely absent-master fallback, identity/cycle-guarded list placement of other document kinds without own-master validation, and commanded relations supply ordered membership independently of worktrees. Record/list disagreements are served once per declaring master and complete content; they do not repair records or supply a second membership map. An agent whose only activity is a running provider subagent counts as working, and its age runs from that subagent's start. Task words and marks format that same native state through the shared presentation table; a started task with none of its agents working and at least one of them limited carries the served limited word with the time left in the place paused would take, and its hover names each limited seat, its provider, its exhausted window and the exact reset, while the counts and the grouping keep saying paused. The Order drawing’s started accent is the explicitly separate presentation choice, not another activity or stage authority. Startup/new-boot reconciliation qualifies host activity while idle/full-heal/degraded wakes do not turn into status polling. Optional summaries, on-demand document bodies, dependency readiness and independent operational projections are not competing task truth. Display age is derived from eventAt and a display clock, not a second served elapsed-age value. Native start and abandon publish task/parent stage through the existing task-fact transaction, attach retains stage, and finalize/reopen retain their distinct authority. Task-source/contract publication rollback is not restoration of already-reclaimed worktrees. A nonzero served global unknown-activity bucket has one shell notice and suppresses works/paused figures; unknown task activity uses the shared started word, not a repeated host sentence. This is presentation, not proof of native host availability or permission to activate the host plugin.
